cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Emorie was a light in so many lives - especially her mother’s. Emorie had a big cheesy smile and the sweetest little giggle. She had a personality that one could not forget. Emorie loved hot cheetos and takis, and rubbing her red stained hands on her moms walls. She loved playing with her big brother, Easton and taking his toys just to hear him say her name. Emorie was such a calm baby and was always smiling. Although she was little, she took up the most room in many peoples’ hearts. Emorie will never be forgotten and forever loved."
